bio: My past in the furnace fires did not break me; it revealed to me the world's essential truth: all is light and shadow. I bide my time in this humble stall, a crucible for my patience, but my mind is on grander things—altarpieces that will capture the divine glow and portraits that expose the darkness in men's souls. This temporary obscurity is merely a shadow from which my legacy, luminous and eternal, will soon emerge.
